Michalis Louis ([[chief executive officer|CEO]]) | area_served = [[Republic of Cyprus]] | industry = [[Bank]]ing, [[financial services]] | revenue = €680.3 million (2023){{Cite web| title=Annual Financial Report For the year ended 31 December 2020 | publisher=Hellenic Bank Group | url=https://www.hellenicbank.com/portalserver/content/api/contentstream-id/ba122ca0-b615-4054-878e-cf272e6e3254/80561a4c-c994-44da-be07-442e8bc50753/PDF/Announcements/2021/Annual%20Financial%20Results%20for%202020/Annual%20Financial%20Report%20for%20the%20year%20ended%2031%20December%202020-EN-new.pdf | archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20220201204305/https://www.hellenicbank.com/portalserver/content/api/contentstream-id/ba122ca0-b615-4054-878e-cf272e6e3254/80561a4c-c994-44da-be07-442e8bc50753/PDF/Announcements/2021/Annual%20Financial%20Results%20for%202020/Annual%20Financial%20Report%20for%20the%20year%20ended%2031%20December%202020-EN-new.pdf | archive-date=2022-02-01}} | operating_income = €405.2 million (2023) | net_income = €365.4 million (2023) | assets = €20.1 billion (2023) | equity = €1.506 billion (2023) | ratio = Capital Ratio: 22.8% fully loaded CET1 (2023) | num_employees = 2,255 (Q1 2024) | owner = [[Eurobank Ergasias|Eurobank]] (100%){{cite news | url=https://www.eurobank.gr/el/omilos/grafeio-tupou/etairiki-anakoinosi-01-12-22/ | title=Η Eurobank ανακοινώνει τη σύναψη συμφωνίας για την απόκτηση ποσοστού 13,41% στην Ελληνική Τράπεζα }}{{cite web | url=https://www.hellenicbank.com/portalserver/hb-en-portal/en/about-us/investor-relations/show-me/stock-information | title=Shareholder Information }} | subsidiaries = Pancyprian Insurance, Hellenic Life, CNP Asfalistiki | website = {{url|http://www.hellenicbank.com}} }} '''Hellenic Bank Public Company Ltd''' ({{langx|el|Ελληνική Τράπεζα Δημόσια Εταιρία Λτδ}}; [[Cyprus Stock Exchange|CSE]]: HB) was a [[bank]] in [[Cyprus]]. It has been designated as a Significant Institution since the entry into force of [[European Banking Supervision]] in late 2014, and as a consequence is directly supervised by the [[European Central Bank]].{{cite web |website=European Central Bank |title=The list of significant supervised entities and the list of less significant institutions |url=https://www.bankingsupervision.europa.eu/ecb/pub/pdf/ssm-listofsupervisedentities1409en.pdf |date={{date|2014/09/04}} }}{{cite web |website=European Central Bank |title=List of supervised entities |date={{date|2023/01/01}} |url=https://www.bankingsupervision.europa.eu/ecb/pub/pdf/ssm.listofsupervisedentities202302.en.pdf }} ==History== The bank was founded in 1976 with technical assistance from [[Bank of America]] and in 1996 it bought the local operations of [[Barclays Bank]].{{citation needed|date=June 2017}} A major shareholder (29%) was traditionally and for many years, the [[Church of Cyprus]]. Between November 2013 and December 2014, the Church's shareholding shrank to 0.3% making it a small shareholder, after Greek bank [[Eurobank Ergasias]] holding 68.81% and Cyprus based Demetra Holdings Plc with 21%, (Logicom Plc the owner of Demetra Holdings Plc also holds c 4% direct shareholding in the bank).{{cite web|url=http://www.philenews.com/oikonomia/kypros/article/678728/elliniki-oi-55-meglyteroi-metochoi-lista|title=Phileleftheros dot com - Hellenic: The 55 largest shareholders (list) in Greek|website=Philenews.com|access-date=30 March 2019}} The board is composed of representatives of the top two shareholders. In January 2011, Hellenic Bank started operating in Russia but later, in 2014, sold the Russian operation{{Cite web |url=http://www.themoscowtimes.com/business/article/cypriot-bank-to-enter-russian-market-in-2011/409049.html |title=Cypriot Bank to Enter Russian Market in 2011 | Business | the Moscow Times |access-date=2010-06-25 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20100628014412/http://www.themoscowtimes.com/business/article/cypriot-bank-to-enter-russian-market-in-2011/409049.html |archive-date=2010-06-28 |url-status=dead }}{{cite web|url=http://oam.cse.com.cy/Announcement/announcementvariation/12649|title=Announcement Variation|website=Oam.cse.com.cy|access-date=13 August 2018|archive-date=21 October 2016|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20161021204640/http://oam.cse.com.cy/Announcement/announcementvariation/12649|url-status=dead}} The bank also had representative offices in Kyiv (Ukraine), St Petersburg and Moscow (Russia) as well as South Africa but later shut them down. It was also opening a representative office in Athens, Greece in 2017.{{Cite web |url=https://www.hellenicbank.com/easyconsole.cfm/id/1437 |title=Hellenic Bank Public Company Ltd - Representative Offices |access-date=2016-09-29 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20161021204243/https://www.hellenicbank.com/easyconsole.cfm/id/1437 |archive-date=2016-10-21 |url-status=dead }} On 25 March 2013 Hellenic Bank sold its Greek branches to [[Piraeus Bank]]. As of 27 March 2013, former Hellenic Bank customers could use the ATMs of all [[Piraeus Bank]] Group banks (Piraeus Bank & [[ATEbank]], [[Geniki Bank]] and former [[Bank of Cyprus]] and [[CPB Bank]] networks) free of charge. The process of merging the operations of the former Hellenic Bank network in Greece into Piraeus Bank was completed in mid-July 2013. This was followed by the closure of the vast majority of the former Hellenic Bank branches and the dismissal of its personnel.{{Cite web |url=http://www.centralbank.gov.cy/nqcontent.cfm?a_id=12677&lang=en |title=Sale of the branches of the three Cypriot banks in Greece - Central Bank of Cyprus |access-date=2016-09-29 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20161002150703/http://www.centralbank.gov.cy/nqcontent.cfm?a_id=12677&lang=en |archive-date=2016-10-02 |url-status=dead }} In 2015 [[EBRD]] acquired a 5.4% share in Hellenic Bank.{{cite web|url=http://www.sigmalive.com/en/news/economy/135775/ebrd-acquires-54-share-in-hellenic-bank|title=EBRD acquires 5.4% share in Hellenic Bank|website=Sigmalive.com|access-date=13 August 2018}} In 2016, Hellenic Bank received a [[Global Finance (magazine)|Global Finance Magazine]] award for the third consecutive year as the Best Digital Bank in Cyprus {{cite web|url=http://www.stockwatch.com.cy/nqcontent.cfm?a_name=news_view&ann_id=260224&lang=en|title=Ελληνική Τράπεζα: Καλύτερη Ηλεκτρονική Τράπεζα Ιδιωτών & Επιχειρήσεων στην Κύπρο|date=24 August 2016|website=Stockwatch.com|access-date=13 August 2018|archive-date=21 October 2016|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20161021210821/http://www.stockwatch.com.cy/nqcontent.cfm?a_name=news_view&ann_id=260224&lang=en|url-status=dead}} and was upgraded to B rating by [[Fitch Ratings|Fitch]].{{cite web|url=http://www.sigmalive.com/en/news/economy/144353/fitch-upgrades-two-cyprus-banks-ratings-to-stable|title=Fitch upgrades two Cyprus banks' ratings to 'stable' - News|website=Sigmalive.com|access-date=13 August 2018}} In July 2017, Hellenic Bank sold 51% of its Arrears Management Division (2.3bn Euro in Non Performing Exposures and 150mn Euro in property), including its Debt Recovery Unit and Property Management Unit to Czech specialised firm APS Holdings a.s and created a new company in which it is a minority 49% shareholder: APS Debt Servicing Cyprus Ltd. 129 Hellenic Bank employees will move to the new company.{{cite web|url=http://www.stockwatch.com.cy/nqcontent.cfm?a_name=news_view&ann_id=269490|title=HB: Νέα εταιρεία για NPLs €2,4 δισ.|date=11 January 2017|website=Stockwatch.com|access-date=13 August 2018|archive-date=16 January 2017|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20170116165335/http://www.stockwatch.com.cy/nqcontent.cfm?a_name=news_view&ann_id=269490|url-status=dead}} In July 2018, Hellenic Bank purchased the performing loans and deposits of the Cyprus Cooperative Bank, including 75 branches and 1,100 staff, raising €150mn in new capital and making it the second largest Cypriot Bank with a 31% share of the Cypriot deposit market and 20% of the loans market. Youssef Nasr became chairman of the board of Directors. In August 2019, Evripides Polycarpou became chairman of the board of Directors. In July 2021 German Oliver Gatzke became CEO.{{Cite web |last= |date=2021-03-23 |title=Hellenic Bank appoints German finance specialist Oliver Gatzke CEO {{!}} Cyprus Mail |url=https://cyprus-mail.com/2021/03/23/hellenic-bank-appoints-german-finance-specialist-oliver-gatzke-ceo/ |access-date=2023-06-16 |website=cyprus-mail.com/ |language=en-GB}} On the 30th of November 2022, [[Wargaming (company)|Wargaming Group Limited]] announced that it reached an agreement to sell a holding of 13.41% (55,337,721 Shares) of Hellenic Bank Public Company Ltd to [[Eurobank Ergasias|Eurobank]] for a consideration of €70 million.{{cite web|url=https://cyprus-mail.com/2022/12/02/wargaming-group-announces-agreement-to-sell-hellenic-bank-share-to-eurobank/|title=Wargaming Group announces agreement to sell Hellenic Bank share to Eurobank|date=2 December 2022|website=Cyprus-Mail.com|access-date=20 December 2022}} If the agreement goes through by the supervisory authorities in Frankfurt, [[Eurobank Ergasias|Eurobank]] will be the major shareholder of the bank with a 26.1% ownership.{{cite web|url=https://cyprus-mail.com/2022/12/01/eurobank-to-become-hellenic-bank-majority-shareholder/|title=Eurobank to become Hellenic Bank main shareholder|date=1 December 2022|website=Cyprus-Mail.com|access-date=20 December 2022}} Early in January 2023, [[Eurobank Ergasias|Eurobank]] announced the acquisition of a 3.2% holding (13,230,000 shares) in Hellenic Bank Public Company Limited from funds managed by Senvest Management LLC, for a consideration of €16.74m, therefore increasing the total holding to 29.2%.{{cite web|url=https://www.stockwatch.com.cy/en/article/trapezes/eurobank-further-increases-its-stake-hellenic-bank |title= Eurobank further increases its stake in Hellenic Bank |date=2 January 2023|website=stockwatch.com.cy|access-date=12 May 2023}} The Bank's NPLs dropped after the completion of Starlight Project. The project was a transaction package that included the securitization of NPLs amounting to approximately €1.4 billion (Starlight Portfolio) on December 31, 2022, and the sale of the Bank's platform, APS Debt Servicer. APS was sold to Themis Portfolio Management Ltd, an indirect subsidiary of Oxalis Holding S.A.R.L., which is managed and advised by [[PIMCO]]. The Bank's NPL Ratio, excluding NPLs covered by the Asset Protection Program (APP) dropped to 3.6% from 13.5%.{{cite web|url=https://www.stockwatch.com.cy/en/article/trapezes/hellenic-bank-completion-starlight-project |title= Hellenic Bank: Completion of Starlight Project |date=31 March 2023|website=stockwatch.com.cy|access-date=12 May 2023}} In June 2023 Christos Themistocleous became interim chairman. In August 2023 Antonis Rouvas became interim CEO. In January 2024 Greek banker [[Petros Christodoulou]] was approved by the European Central Bank as Chairman. Christos Themistocleous returned to the Vice Chairman role. In September 2024 Michalis Louis became CEO. In September 2024, [[Eurobank Ergasias|Eurobank]] acquired a 26.1% stake in Hellenic Bank, thus increasing its share in Hellenic Bank to 55.9%.{{Cite web |title=Competition watchdog approves Eurobank's acquisition of Hellenic Bank stake |url=https://cyprus-mail.com/2024/09/16/competition-watchdog-approves-eurobanks-acquisition-of-hellenic-bank-stake/ |access-date=7 November 2024|date=16 September 2024}} On 7 November 2024, Eurobank further increased its stake in Hellenic Bank to 68.81% of the shares and launched a full bid on Hellenic.{{Cite web |title=Eurobank Boosts Stake in Hellenic Bank Cyprus to 68.81 % |url=https://www.tovima.com/finance/eurobank-boosts-stake-in-hellenic-bank-cyprus-to-68-81/ |date=7 November 2024}} On 11 February 2025, Eurobank'stake in Hellenic Bank reached 93.47% of the shares and Eurobank launched a mandatory public offer to acquire the remaining shares of Hellenic Bank.{{Cite web |title=Eurobank raises stake in Hellenic Bank to 93.47 per cent, eyes full control |url=https://cyprus-mail.com/2025/02/11/eurobank-raises-stake-in-hellenic-bank-to-93-47-per-cent-eyes-full-control |date=11 February 2025}} After obtaining the full ownership of Hellenic Bank, Eurobank Ergasias initiated a merger of Hellenic Bank with its Cypriot subsidiary (Eurobank Cyprus), that was finalised on 1 September 2025 and discontinued the 'Hellenic Bank' brand.{{Cite web |title=Announcement - Merger of Hellenic Bank with Eurobank Cyprus |url=https://www.eurobank.gr/en/group/grafeio-tupou/etairiki-anakoinosi-29-08-2025 |date=29 August 2025}} ==See also== {{Portal|Banks}} * [[2012–2013 Cypriot financial crisis]] * [[List of banks in Cyprus]] ==References== {{Reflist}} ==External links== *[https://www.hellenicbank.com Hellenic Bank Group] {{Members of Euro Banking Association}} [[Category:Banks under direct supervision of the European Central Bank]] [[Category:1976 establishments in Cyprus]] [[Category:Companies based in Nicosia]] [[Category:Banks established in 1976]] [[Category:Defunct banks of Cyprus]] [[Category:Companies listed on the Cyprus Stock Exchange]]
extract: Hellenic Bank Public Company Ltd (Greek: Ελληνική Τράπεζα Δημόσια Εταιρία Λτδ; CSE: HB) was a bank in Cyprus. It has been designated as a Significant Institution since the entry into force of European Banking Supervision in late 2014, and as a consequence is directly supervised by the European Central Bank.
